points.speaker: Jeanne Shaheen
points.quote:
Mr. President, colleagues, every day that Russia earns 
billions from energy exports, it has more resources to finance this 
war. Every day that Putin has those resources, he gains more time. 
Every day that Putin gains more time, more Ukrainians are killed.
points.summary: Every day that Russia earns billions from energy exports, it has more resources to finance this war. Every day that Putin has those resources, he gains more time. Every day that Putin gains more time, more Ukrainians are killed.

points.speaker: Rand Paul
points.quote:
Mr. President, the bill before us contains the largest tax 
increase ever passed by a Republican Congress. Worse yet, the bill 
transfers the taxing authority from the legislature to the executive 
branch, an unconstitutional delegation of power.
points.summary: the bill before us contains the largest tax increase ever passed by a Republican Congress

selection.reason: Supports the bill as a way to cut off Russian war funding and reduce Ukrainian casualties.

selection.speaker: John Cornyn
selection.quote:
Mr. President, Mr. Fetterman and I appreciate the work 
being done to advance the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran 
Act of 2026, H.R.5334, in the Senate. This bill will honor Senator 
Graham's legacy, help dismantle Putin's war machine, and strengthen the 
U.S. national security.
selection.summary: This bill will honor Senator Graham's legacy, help dismantle Putin's war machine, and strengthen the U.S. national security.
selection.reason: States direct support for the bill and its security benefits.

selection.speaker: Darline Graham
selection.quote:
Mr. President, I rise today, and I am honored to 
reiterate my full support for the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia 
and Iran Act of 2026.
selection.summary: I rise today, and I am honored to reiterate my full support for the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026.

selection.speaker: Katie Boyd Britt
selection.quote:
Mr. President, the Senate has a spine. That is exactly 
what we are doing here today is standing with a steel spine. We are 
standing against Putin's aggression.
selection.summary: The Senate has a spine. That is exactly what we are doing here today is standing with a steel spine. We are standing against Putin's aggression.
selection.reason: Presents the vote as opposing Putin's aggression.

selection.speaker: Jeanne Shaheen
selection.quote:
This legislation is what President Zelenskyy asked us to do. This is 
what Senator Graham worked so hard to achieve. I hope we can give it an 
overwhelming vote.
selection.summary: This legislation is what President Zelenskyy asked us to do. This is what Senator Graham worked so hard to achieve. I hope we can give it an overwhelming vote.
selection.reason: Supports the bill as aligned with Zelenskyy’s request and Graham’s effort.

selection.speaker: Darline Graham
selection.quote:
This legislation hits Putin where it hurts. It contains provisions 
that specifically target those who are supporting Russia's war in 
Ukraine. This bill forces those primary countries keeping Russia's 
economy afloat to make a simple yet critical choice--a choice between 
doing business with America or buying cheap Russian energy. This 
legislation tells Russia's customers that the United States of America 
will not sit by while they fund Putin's assault.
selection.summary: This legislation hits Putin where it hurts. It contains provisions that specifically target those who are supporting Russia's war in Ukraine. This bill forces those primary countries keeping Russia's economy afloat to make a simple yet critical choice--a choice between doing business with America or buying cheap Russian energy. This legislation tells Russia's customers that the United States of America will not sit by while they fund Putin's assault.
selection.reason: Argues the bill targets supporters of Russia’s war and pressures customers financing Putin’s assault.

selection.speaker: Rand Paul
selection.quote:
Mr. President, the bill before us contains the largest tax 
increase ever passed by a Republican Congress. Worse yet, the bill 
transfers the taxing authority from the legislature to the executive 
branch, an unconstitutional delegation of power.
selection.summary: the bill before us contains the largest tax increase ever passed by a Republican Congress
selection.reason: Opposing a bill on the basis of an enormous tax increase is a direct substantive reason to vote no.

selection.speaker: Rand Paul
selection.quote:
Mr. President, the bill before us contains the largest tax 
increase ever passed by a Republican Congress. Worse yet, the bill 
transfers the taxing authority from the legislature to the executive 
branch, an unconstitutional delegation of power.
selection.summary: the bill transfers the taxing authority from the legislature to the executive branch, an unconstitutional delegation of power
selection.reason: Claiming the bill makes an unconstitutional transfer of taxing authority is a direct substantive reason to vote no.

selection.speaker: Rand Paul
selection.quote:
Madison believed the Republic would survive only if the Constitution 
divided the power and pitted the executive ambition against legislative 
ambition. Madison would be horrified by the clamor of so many in 
Congress to cede the taxing authority.
selection.summary: Madison would be horrified by the clamor of so many in Congress to cede the taxing authority
selection.reason: Arguing that Congress should not cede taxing authority is a direct substantive reason to vote no.

selection.speaker: Rand Paul
selection.quote:
My amendment strips the transfer of the taxing authority from the 
bill. My amendment--if it passes--will demonstrate that Congress still 
has a spine, still has ambition, and still supports the separation and 
limitation of power.
selection.summary: My amendment strips the transfer of the taxing authority from the bill
selection.reason: Removing the transfer of taxing authority is presented as the key substantive objection supporting a no vote on the bill as written.
